from solution import repeat_tuples


def test_issue_example_four_repeats():
    """Repeat the given tuple n times like repeat_tuples((1, 3), 4)."""
    result = repeat_tuples((1, 3), 4)
    expected = ((1, 3), (1, 3), (1, 3), (1, 3))  # N=4 -> 4 copies of (1, 3)
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_single_repeat():
    """Repeat the given tuple once gives one copy."""
    result = repeat_tuples((1, 3), 1)
    expected = ((1, 3),)  # N=1 -> 1 copy of (1, 3)
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_zero_repeats():
    """Repeat the given tuple zero times gives empty tuple."""
    result = repeat_tuples((1, 3), 0)
    expected = ()  # N=0 -> 0 copies, length 0
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_empty_input_tuple():
    """Repeat the given empty tuple 3 times gives three empty tuples."""
    result = repeat_tuples((), 3)
    expected = ((), (), ())  # N=3 -> 3 copies of ()
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_single_element_twice():
    """Repeat single-element tuple twice gives two nested copies."""
    result = repeat_tuples((5,), 2)
    expected = ((5,), (5,))  # N=2 -> 2 copies of (5,)
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_three_element_thrice():
    """Repeat (1, 2, 3) three times gives three copies."""
    result = repeat_tuples((1, 2, 3), 3)
    expected = ((1, 2, 3), (1, 2, 3), (1, 2, 3))  # N=3 -> 3 copies of (1, 2, 3)
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_string_elements_twice():
    """Repeat tuple of strings twice duplicates the whole tuple."""
    result = repeat_tuples(("a", "b"), 2)
    expected = (("a", "b"), ("a", "b"))  # N=2 -> 2 copies of ('a', 'b')
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_mixed_types_twice():
    """Repeat mixed-type tuple twice duplicates the whole tuple."""
    result = repeat_tuples((1, "x", None), 2)
    expected = ((1, "x", None), (1, "x", None))  # N=2 -> 2 copies of (1, 'x', None)
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_outer_length_equals_n():
    """Repeating n times must produce an outer tuple of length n."""
    result = repeat_tuples((1, 3), 4)
    expected_len = 4  # N=4 -> outer length 4
    assert len(result) == expected_len


def test_contract_result_is_tuple():
    """Repeating the given tuple n times must return a tuple."""
    result = repeat_tuples((1, 3), 2)  # N=2 -> 2 copies in a tuple
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
